metadata.description: Agent Skills for your own product or project, starting with video.

plugins.name: omnigami-skill-finder
plugins.description: Recommend which omnigami skill fits a job for the user's own product, or say honestly that none does. Reads the product and the request, chooses from omnigami's published catalogue (a free skill whenever one meets the brief), and returns the install line, the first request filled in for the product, and one alternative with its trade-off. Use when the user asks which omnigami skill to use for a film, scene, image set or deck, or names this skill. It recommends only: it installs, buys and makes nothing.

plugins.name: omnigami-device-mockups
plugins.description: Device mockups from your product's real screens: photoreal laptop and phone stills on a pale studio ground, with an optional headline. Editable HTML and PNGs, wide and tall. Use for device mockups, iPhone or MacBook mockups, website hero images, screenshots in devices or social product images.

plugins.name: omnigami-screen-lit-mockups
plugins.description: Make screen-lit device stills from a product’s real dark phone screen: an angled phone in the product accent light, an optional product headline, or a near-frontal tall phone with an optional photographic generated hand. Delivers editable self-contained HTML and PNGs at 1920 × 1080 and 1080 × 1920. Use for dark app mockups, screen-lit phone imagery, website hero artwork or social product images.

plugins.name: omnigami-product-film
plugins.description: Launch video from your product's real screens: 34 seconds in five acts (problem, promise, the product at work, result, ask) with a big cursor, a moving camera, captions and sound, in wide, square and tall, with an optional narrated version. Use when the user asks for a launch video, product video, promo, demo video, teaser or motion graphics for their product, app or website.

plugins.name: omnigami-cutout-film
plugins.description: Make a 30–40 second launch film of a software product's real UI in a stepped, illustrated cutout style - 12 fps with every frame a new drawing and no motion blur, flat colour fields changed by hard cuts, the product's own screens redrawn large as vectors, an oversized leaning cursor, mock-3D cutout objects with thickness, an ink outline and a hard shadow, devices taken only from the product's own world, and room to read every beat. Renders a wide (16:9) and a tall (9:16) MP4 with music. Use when the user asks for a premium launch video, product film, illustrated or animated promo, motion graphics, or a cutout or stop-motion style film for their app, web product or tool.

plugins.name: omnigami-device-film
plugins.description: Make a 40–48 second launch film of a software product's real screens on photoreal 3D devices (a laptop and a phone), with captions as their own shots centred on a light field with one word in the brand's colour, dark hardware large at strong angles that eases hard into place, a laptop that glides in and opens with its lid sweeping across the words, the real UI full frame, phones that spin into a lineup, cuts on the music's bar lines. Renders a wide (16:9) and a tall (9:16) MP4 with music. Use when the user asks for a premium launch video, a product film with devices, a keynote-style film, or a device mockup video of their app.

plugins.name: omnigami-ui-morph
plugins.description: UI animation of one real task in your product: one shape that never cuts morphs from button to card to control to result, with a cursor, captions and a song, as a 16-second looping square MP4. Use for feature announcements, launch clips, landing-page loops, UI animations and UI teasers.

plugins.name: omnigami-chat-launch
plugins.description: Chat-style launch video for a product you ask for things (an assistant, search, booking, ordering): a request typed into its real composer, the product working one step a beat, its results bursting out, ending on the brand. 23 seconds, tall, with sound. Use when the user asks for a launch video, promo, teaser or motion graphics for such a product.

plugins.name: omnigami-unfold
plugins.description: Make a 30-second keynote-style launch video for a product in code, as one continuous take. Every scene is made out of the one before it (a wordmark's letters drop away from its period, the dot becomes a pill, an iris opens onto the product, a grid of its screens, a zoom, a glass toolbar and slider, the product's own flow, a phone and its lock screen, a dot that floods onto the real result and back), driven by a cursor, with a screen-studio camera, cut to 120 BPM, with sound. Renders looping tall (9:16) and wide (16:9) MP4s. Use when the user asks for a launch video, keynote-style film, product video, promo or motion graphics for their product, app or website.

plugins.name: omnigami-language-launch
plugins.description: Localization announcement video: "<name> now speaks" over each language's own name, one phone per language showing your real translated screens, then all of them in a row. 15 seconds, tall, with sound. Use when the user asks for a localization, translation, "now in N languages", new languages or international launch video.

plugins.name: omnigami-milestone
plugins.description: Milestone video for a product: one tap on the thing it counts, that result multiplying into thousands as a counter rolls to your number, a thank-you, then your app's icon. 16 seconds, tall, with sound. Use when the user asks for a milestone, "we hit N users", thank-you, anniversary or celebration video.

plugins.name: omnigami-illustrated-ad
plugins.description: Illustrated ad for a physical product: its ingredients drawn in engraved ink, stroke by stroke, the photoreal product rising in front of each, then the whole range and the call to action. 16 seconds, tall, with sound. Use when the user asks for an illustrated ad, product ad, packaging film or drawn animation for a drink, food, cosmetic or other product range.

plugins.name: omnigami-whats-new
plugins.description: Release video from your changelog and real screens, made again for every version, in wide, square and tall. Use for a what's-new clip, an app update, a release notes or changelog video, or a new version announcement.

plugins.name: omnigami-product-reel
plugins.description: Product reel of everything you make: photographed items on the beat, real shop or app screens, count-ups, an orbiting collection and your brand and address held at the end, in tall, square and wide. Use for "show everything we make", collection showcases, catalogue reels and short social reels of a range.

plugins.name: omnigami-struck-hook
plugins.description: Opening hook for a launch video: the old way in three huge lines that slam in on the beat, then each struck through in your brand colour. 5 seconds, square, wide and tall, with sound. Use when the user asks for a hook, an opener, a "the old way" or "before" moment, a problem statement or kinetic type for a launch video, teaser or ad.

plugins.name: omnigami-typed-promise
plugins.description: Name reveal for a launch video: your mark opens into a prompt bar that types one line and sends it, then lands beside your product's name and its one-line promise. 6 seconds, square, wide and tall, with sound. Use when the user asks for a product, name or logo reveal or a "type a prompt" moment, especially for an AI tool, search or command-line tool.

plugins.name: omnigami-end-card
plugins.description: End card for a launch video: your mark, name, address, the one action (a line to type or your own button) and a tagline, landing on the beat and held to the last frame. 4 seconds, square, wide and tall, with sound. Use when the user asks for an end card, outro, closing frame, call to action or logo lockup for a launch video, teaser, demo or ad.

plugins.name: omnigami-cursor-camera
plugins.description: Cursor-zoom demo of one real task on your product's screens: a big cursor glides, clicks, scrolls and drags while the camera pushes in and pulls back with it, ending on the result. 18 seconds, square, wide and tall, with sound. Use when the user asks for a cursor zoom, an auto-zoom demo, a screen-recording-style walkthrough or a feature clip.

plugins.name: omnigami-terminal-film
plugins.description: Make or revise a terminal film: a roughly 31-second launch film for a developer tool with a real CLI or terminal UI. Adapt the included finished film with the user's real terminal captures, big amber headlines before each run of screens, a moving outline wordmark wall and an extruded 3D brand ending. Produces a wide 16:9 and a tall 9:16 MP4 with the skill's own song, its synth score or the user's own music.

plugins.name: omnigami-headline-film
plugins.description: Make a headline film: a wide launch film with large stepped uppercase headlines around real app cards, brief lookalike letter substitutions, close UI actions, fast montage bookends and a slash wipe. Use for a music-led app launch or product promo built from real screens.

plugins.name: omnigami-walkthrough-film
plugins.description: Make or revise a walkthrough film: an editorial product film following one real item through its history, with large type, alternating ink and paper pages, dated corner labels, captured product panels, halftone resolves, dither transitions and a meaningful dot field. Adapts a finished 31-second film and renders a wide (16:9) and a tall (9:16) MP4 with a score. Use for a brand or launch film built around one invoice, meeting, request or other product journey.

plugins.name: omnigami-assistant-film
plugins.description: Make or revise an assistant film: a software launch film of an assistant completing one real workflow. Captured product screens sit on 3D planes, UI elements rise from their actual slots, and the camera follows the action with shallow focus. Delivers an editable, self-contained film and renders a wide (16:9) and a tall (9:16) MP4 with music. Use for an assistant launch, an agent feature announcement, or a cinematic product demo with real UI in depth.

plugins.name: omnigami-statement-film
plugins.description: Make a statement film: a roughly 60-second type-led launch film of a software workflow, with large serif statements, the user's real request typed large and opened into the app, three brand-colour fields, real app windows opening from circle stand-ins, tilted close-ups, visible presses, a payoff line whose circle holds the real result and grows into a product-derived frame that closes into the mark. Use for a narrated-by-captions product or agent launch video. Renders a wide (16:9) and a tall (9:16) MP4 with music and effects, plus the editable HTML film.

plugins.name: omnigami-collage-film
plugins.description: Make a roughly 33-second editorial launch film from a product's real screens, printed like an annual report, with numbered spreads on the brand's colour with one paper and one ink spread, two-ink halftone photo plates, hairline rules, small-capital captions and directed spread changes on a musical grid. Use for a textured collage product film or an editorial software launch video. Renders a wide (16:9) and a tall (9:16) MP4 and ships the editable canvas film.

plugins.name: omnigami-android-style-logo-reveal
plugins.description: Logo reveal built from your mark's own geometry: grid lines and compass circles construct it while short benefit lines land beside it, then a push into its colour, your line, and a pull back to the lockup. 15.5 seconds, wide, with music; an independent style study of Android's 2019 brand film. Use when the user asks for a logo reveal, logo animation, brand opener, intro or mark animation.

plugins.name: omnigami-question-film
plugins.description: Tall app ad for a product that answers requests: your users' questions fill the screen in your own input style, each folding up as your product's real answer rises under it, closing on your input and lockup. 30 seconds, 9:16, with music; an independent style study of Spotify's "Now you can talk to Spotify" ad. Use for a vertical app ad, a Reel, TikTok or Shorts ad for an assistant, search, chat or booking product, or a "talk to it" film.

plugins.name: omnigami-verb-sting
plugins.description: Make a 13.5-second sting of a product, wide (16:9) and tall (9:16, for TikTok, Reels and Shorts), in code, with the product's wordmark dressed in its own screens resolving to white, then short imperative phrases, one per shot ("Bill it.", "Send it.", "Get paid."), each splitting so the product's real screen pops in between its words and does that action on the beat (a pointer glides in, hovers, presses, and the app's real next state holds to read), hard cuts on a 120 BPM grid, and the exact lockup landing on a bar line. Renders an MP4 in each size with music. Use when the user asks for a verb sting, a sting, a short punchy product ad, an "it does this, and this" film, a keynote-style feature roll or a short launch teaser of their app's real actions.

plugins.name: omnigami-verb-film
plugins.description: Make a 9.5-second film of a product, in code, wide (16:9) and tall (9:16) - the product's wordmark opening dressed in its own materials and resolving to white, then six short imperative phrases, one per shot ("Bill it.", "Send it.", "Get paid."), each acting out its own verb in its type with a real piece of the product (the words typed while an amount ticks up, an outline filled solid and sent, a status pill stepping, a burst of the app's own notifications, its list spun onto the phrase, its chart bar lifting the last word), hard cuts on a 120 BPM grid, and the exact lockup on a bar line. Renders MP4s with music. Use when the user asks for a verb film, a kinetic type film or sting of their product's verbs, a short punchy product ad, an "it does this, and this" film or a short launch teaser in wide and tall.

plugins.name: omnigami-journey-film
plugins.description: Make a 20–35 second film of one journey through a product, one step per shot — the first thing a person does, each step after it, the moment it pays off — on photoreal 3D devices (a laptop and a phone) that land on bold flat grounds in front of one big still word, the product's real screens changing exactly as the app does, the journey's steps as the film's graphic, the product's own line typed at the payoff and contracting into its real card, and an end that closes into the product's own outline or its lockup. The film is a rounded card on a page; cuts land on a 120 BPM grid with the skill's own song. Renders tall (9:16) and wide (16:9) MP4s with music, each composed for its frame. Use when the user asks for a product journey or how-it-works film, a flow explained end to end (sending an invoice, ordering, booking, checking out, publishing), or a product video that shows how the product is used, tall for TikTok, Reels or Shorts and wide for YouTube or a site.

plugins.name: omnigami-share-cards
plugins.description: Give every page of a website its own link-preview card, made from the product's real screens in one family of layouts, wire the og:image and Twitter tags, and keep new pages covered. Use when someone wants OG images, social cards or link previews for their site, docs, changelog or blog, or says their links unfurl with a generic image or none.

plugins.name: omnigami-app-store-screenshots
plugins.description: Make an eight-image iPhone App Store screenshot set from an app's real screens and brand. Short lowercase benefit captions sit above large photoreal phones cropped by the frame; distinct physical turns alternate with straight phones, and a genuine device-free collection changes the scale. The first three images explain the category, promise and first result. Delivers editable self-contained HTML and ordered opaque PNGs at 1320 × 2868 and 1206 × 2622, each composed for its size. Use for an iOS app listing, App Store screenshots, a store screenshot redesign or a coordinated screenshot set. Use a video skill for an App Store preview movie.

plugins.name: omnigami-product-deck
plugins.description: Make a product presentation from the product's real screens, with one benefit title and one large native piece per slide, restrained space, live photoreal hardware where supported, and speaker talking points. Delivers an offline HTML deck, a matching PDF, a silent 1920 × 1080 MP4 and a PowerPoint file with editable titles and notes. Use for a product demo deck, launch presentation, feature presentation or sales walkthrough to present live. A document intended to be read alone needs a different layout.

plugins.name: omnigami-app-store-preview
plugins.description: Make an iPhone App Store preview and matching tall social film from real app-usage recordings. Capture the user's phone app with native feedback and a travelling touch pointer, or use their own device recording. Deliver checked 886 × 1920 and 1080 × 1920 MP4s, full-frame store footage, a live 3D social phone with optical focus, the included song, editable local source and posters.

plugins.name: omnigami-sales-deck
plugins.description: Make a product deck to send, read and forward from real product screens, with explanatory copy, large native evidence and one next action. Delivers offline HTML, PDF, silent MP4 and editable-text PPTX in the requested languages. Use for a sales leave-behind, product guide or pre-read that must make sense without a presenter.

plugins.name: omnigami-pitch-deck
plugins.description: Make a fundraising pitch deck from a product's real screens and the owner's supplied business facts. Plan the investor argument and design traceable market, traction, model, team and ask graphics. Delivers offline HTML with presenter notes, PDF, silent 1920 × 1080 MP4 and PPTX with editable titles and notes. Use for an investor presentation at pre-seed, seed or later; never invent missing business evidence.

plugins.name: omnigami-launch-kit
plugins.description: Make a coordinated launch campaign from a product's real screens and one recent change. A six-card argument becomes portrait and square carousels, a LinkedIn PDF, feed and story images, X and LinkedIn headers, link previews and matching post copy. Use for a product launch kit, feature announcement campaign or matching launch assets across social platforms.

plugins.name: omnigami-flow-diagram
plugins.description: Make a product flow diagram from a product's real screens — one stable graph of the product's own panels (where work arrives, where it runs, where it recovers, where the result lands) joined by thin permanent connectors, with small signals that travel along them at a constant speed and arrive exactly when the receiving panel changes, the app's real states captured from the app itself. Delivers a seamless silent loop (MP4, WebM and a GIF for a README) and a still PNG that reads without motion, wide (1216 × 1000) and as a 800 × 1352 reflow for READMEs and docs. Use when the user asks for a how-it-works diagram, an architecture or workflow diagram of their product, a pipeline or job-flow animation, an animated diagram for a README or docs page, or a loop showing how their product handles a hand-off, a failure and a retry.

plugins.name: omnigami-changelog-clips
plugins.description: Make one short UI demo per shipped change from a web app's real screens. Delivers separate silent web, square and portrait MP4/WebM clips, result posters and editable source. Use for changelog media, release-note loops and individual feature-update clips; use a whole release-film skill for a montage.

plugins.name: omnigami-recording-film
plugins.description: Make a product film from the user's own phone screen recording. Play one complete real task at normal speed on a photoreal live 3D phone, with five macro camera views joined by four hard cuts, shallow focus that reaches each press early, a black studio and a static brand close. Deliver 9:16 and 16:9 MP4s with music and editable source. If no recording is supplied, capture real usage of the user's web app in its phone layout, including native loading, presses and scrolling. Use for a screen-recording video, phone demo film or cinematic recording treatment.

plugins.name: omnigami-live-demo
plugins.description: Make a silent guided product demo from one real task, its native confirmation and its lasting result. Deliver a self-contained HTML embed with Pause, Replay, reduced-motion and text equivalents, plus a matching 16:9 MP4. Use for an in-page product walkthrough, homepage demo or short task demonstration from the user's actual app and sample data.

plugins.name: omnigami-exploded-view-film
plugins.description: Make an exploded view launch film of a physical product from its accurate 3D model and internal parts. One opening and one reassembly follow the real assembly, with a part per story beat, benefit captions, a flow line, photoreal materials and music. Makes separate wide (16:9) and tall (9:16) MP4s using Blender plates and a Python compositor. Use for a hardware launch, a product cutaway, an exploded assembly film or an explanation of how a physical product works.

plugins.name: omnigami-prompt-reel
plugins.description: Make a reel of a product's real prompts and the outputs they made: converging statements, a typed prompt with name tokens, one output opening from the bar, a burst that gets faster, a registered change of subject and your brand at the close. Wide and tall MP4s with music. Use for AI tools, generators, builders, agents and products where a request becomes a result.
